caption: The drawing features a single, vertically-oriented object centered on a plain, light beige background. The main object appears to be a metallic or brass instrument or tool, with a cylindrical and tiered structure, rendered in shades of brown and gold, showing highlights and shadows to indicate its rounded and metallic surface. The object has a wide, flat base, tapering upwards in several narrower cylindrical sections and finishing with a slightly raised, flat top. There are two smaller inset illustrations: one in the top left corner shows a circular monogram or symbol and a scale measurement; the one in the top right corner is a line drawing showing the object's outline and proportions, labeled with dimensions. The artist's signature "Edgar G. Lampon 20.1.36" is written in the bottom right corner of the page. The entire composition is bordered by a fine line forming a rectangle within the outer edges of the paper.
title: Letter Seal
